messages:
Sam (Account Executive): quick sync 1 Client: MetroCity Health. Procurement pushed back on the PO because legal wants a vendor-signed KMS/HSM attestation and Finance needs a split-invoice option for the 6-month reserved commit. They also insist on a one-page POC SLA + BOM.
Priya (Legal): can you drop the PO they uploaded? I want to check any added audit or indemnity language. also, do they request any nonstandard audit rights?
Sam (Account Executive): pasted the portal snippet they uploaded:

```
PO: MC-PO-2026-2051
Amount: $72,000 (6-month reserved capacity)
Instance: dedicated-8xA100
Billing: asked for quarterly invoices (2 invoices)
Security: vendor-signed HSM attestation required; customer DPA attached with redlines
Signature: DocuSign preferred to procurement@metrocity.gov + legal@metrocity.gov
```

Ravi (Solutions): note: if this is Dedicated we can support customer-managed keys (BYO-KMS) with HSM-backed keys. That usually satisfies attestation requests. For Hosted we only offer vendor-managed keys.
Nora (Security): we have a standard HSM attestation template our infra lead signs. For vendor-signed attestation we'll need Legal to include a one-page attestation addendum. I can also attach SOC2 excerpt and key-rotation docs.
Ethan (Finance): quarterly invoices OK pending PO pdf and agreed payment start. two items: 1) confirm invoice at term-start vs usage-start, 2) set a $15k exposure cap while the POC is running. If they want invoice at usage-start, that's treated as postpaid and needs credit approval.
Priya (Legal): action plan: I'll prepare a DPA redline and the HSM attestation addendum. propose countersign window of 4 business days. also propose limiting subprocessors to essential ones and requiring notice for new subprocessors.
Sam (Account Executive): asked procurement to confirm Dedicated vs Hosted; PM replied Dedicated preferred. They confirmed DocuSign route and provided signer emails (procurement + legal).
redwood-bot: infra-note: dedicated-8xA100 (us-west-2) canary pool spare capacity: 14% for next 10 days.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll draft a one-page POC BOM + SLA snippet (p90 latency target, 99.5% uptime, fallback to lower-capacity model) and attach to the orderform. keeps procurement happy.
Nora (Security): I'll upload the attestation PDF and KMS architecture diagram once Priya confirms addendum wording.
Ethan (Finance): I'll pre-approve quarterly invoicing conditional on the $15k exposure cap and invoice-at-term-start. If they insist usage-start, need finance credit review.
Priya (Legal): please send the portal link to the uploaded customer DPA so I can track their redlines. Sam, can you add the PO pdf here?
Sam (Account Executive): portal link: https://portal.redwood.ai/uploads/MC-PO-2026-2051.pdf :paperclip:
Sam (Account Executive): one small ask from procurement: can we include a short clause that the countersign turnaround won't exceed 5 business days, else the PO auto-terminates? they suggested this to keep timelines tight.
Priya (Legal): we'll try to avoid auto-termination language; propose instead a mutual good-faith countersign ETA (4 business days) and an escalation contact.
Ravi (Solutions): action items summary: 1) Priya to post DPA redline + HSM addendum by EOD. 2) Nora to attach attestation + SOC2 excerpt after addendum approved. 3) Ethan to confirm quarterly invoice workflow after PO pdf verified. 4) Ravi to upload POC BOM + SLA snippet tomorrow morning. 5) Sam to confirm DocuSign signer emails and countersign deadline.
Sam (Account Executive): thanks team 68 will follow up with procurement and circle back with signer emails. please @me when docs land. :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): will post drafts and tag thread.
Nora (Security): will attach attestation and KMS docs in follow-up.
Ethan (Finance): will start a billing ticket once PO pdf and invoice cadence confirmed.
Sam (Account Executive): closing for now, will reopen thread if procurement responds with further redlines.
